_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#0. The rule holds (PARTICLE DYNAMIC/SPH is mandatory for a PD run) but both quoted Signals are fabricated. Deleting the sub-section from upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml aborts with 'negative initial particle spacing!' from particle/src/interaction/4C_particle_interaction_sph.cpp — INITIALPARTICLESPACING lives there and sets every particle's mass. There is no 'pd_neighbor_pairs = 0' string and no 'BOUNDARYPARTICLEFORMULATION not set'. 4C does print 'Number of pd_neighbor_pairs in peridynamic evaluation on this proc: N' every step, but that is the inter-body CONTACT pair count and it is 0 on essentially every step of the baseline run that passes all ten of its result tests, so reading 0 there as an error is a false-alarm generator. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Number of pd_neighbor_pairs in peridynamic evaluation on this proc: 0

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the PARTICLE DYNAMIC/SPH sub-section in the second arm too. The abort and its diagnostic vanish and EXIT_NOSPH becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
